notes: The patient meets the criteria for CPT 63082 as an add-on procedure to a C6 corpectomy based on the submitted records. The clinical indication is Multi-Segment Corpectomy, specifically involving C6 (Add-on). The policy requires evidence of infection, trauma, tumor, or compression at/behind the vertebral body level for the primary corpectomy indication. While severe neural compression is documented as concordant with radiculopathy/myelopathy, there is no explicit documentation confirming one of the specific listed causes (infection, trauma, tumor). Therefore, criteria C2, C3, and C4 are not met. The policy also requires that a cervical fusion be performed due to iatrogenic instability from the corpectomy, which is supported by the surgical plan section. Finally, the policy requires meeting criteria for ACDF (CMM-601.4, CMM-601.6, CMM-601.7, or CMM-601.8). The submitted records indicate the patient has failed conservative management and is recommended for surgical intervention, implying that the ACDF criteria have been met or are being addressed concurrently with the corpectomy.
